faq.title: Developer FAQ
faq.subtitle: Everything you need to integrate your products with LicenseOS.
faq.q1_1: How do I become a developer on LicenseOS?
faq.q1_1_a2: Navigate to the Developer → Apply page from your user menu or footer links.
faq.q1_1_a3: Fill in your developer profile (name, website, description) and submit.
faq.q1_1_a4: Once approved by admin, you'll get access to the Developer Dashboard.
faq.q1_1_a5: From Dashboard, go to Products → Create to publish your first product.
faq.q1_2: How do I get an API Key?
faq.q1_2_intro: After your developer account is approved:
faq.q1_2_a3: Copy the key — it will only be shown once.
faq.q1_2_a4: Use this key in your SDK initialization as the api_key parameter.
faq.q2_1: Quick Start: Integrate LicenseOS SDK in a WordPress plugin
faq.q2_1_desc: Download the SDK file from the platform and include it in your plugin. Initialize in your plugin's main file:
faq.q2_1_note: This enables license activation, status checking, and automatic updates directly within WordPress.
faq.q2_2: How to add a license activation page in my plugin?
faq.q2_2_desc: Create a settings page where users enter their license key, then call the SDK:
faq.q2_3: How to check license status on every page load?
faq.q2_3_desc: Use a cached check to avoid API calls on every request. Verify once per hour:
faq.q3_1_activate: Activate a license key for a domain
faq.q3_1_note: Pass API Key via X-API-KEY header. All responses are JSON.
faq.q4_1: How to push a new version?
faq.q4_1_a1: Go to Developer → Products, click your product.
faq.q4_1_a2: In the Upload New Version section, fill in version number, ZIP file and changelog.
faq.q4_1_a4: All customers with active licenses will see the update automatically.
faq.q5_1_a: Each product supports multiple pricing tiers: trial, monthly, quarterly, semi-annual, annual, and lifetime. Configure tiers in your product's Edit → Pricing Tiers section.
faq.q5_2_a: When a sale is made, the platform deducts a commission fee. The remaining amount is your developer income. Check Developer → Payouts for details.
faq.q6_1: How do I withdraw my earnings?
faq.q6_1_a1: Set up your payout account in Developer → Payouts → Payout Methods.
faq.q6_1_a2: Supported methods: Bank transfer, PayPal, Alipay, WeChat Pay.
faq.q6_1_a3: Click Request Payout and enter the amount.
faq.q6_1_a4: Admin reviews and processes the payout.

faq.q7_3_a3: Regenerate a new key if needed.
docs.title: Documentation
docs.page_desc: Complete reference for integrating LicenseOS into your products.
docs.intro_text: LicenseOS provides a RESTful API for software license management. All API endpoints are versioned under /api/v2.
docs.qs_1: Register as a developer and get approved.
docs.qs_2: Generate an API Key from the Developer Dashboard.
docs.qs_3: Use the API Key in the X-API-KEY request header.
docs.qs_4: Integrate the SDK or call API endpoints directly from your software.
docs.auth_text: Protected endpoints require an API key passed via the X-API-KEY header.
docs.activate_desc: Activate a license key on a specific domain. This creates a domain binding that allows the license to be used on that domain.
docs.check_desc: Check the current status and validity of a license key. Use this to verify licenses before granting access to features.
docs.status_valid: License is active and not expired
docs.status_expired: License has passed its expiry date
docs.status_inactive: License has been deactivated by admin
docs.update_check_desc: Check if a newer version of a product is available. Used by the WordPress SDK for auto-update functionality.
docs.download_desc: Secure download endpoint that validates the license key before serving the ZIP file. Returns the product archive directly.
docs.sdk_intro: The LicenseOS WordPress SDK provides drop-in integration for WP plugins. It handles license activation, status checking, and automatic updates.
docs.sdk_i1: Download licenseos-sdk.php from your Developer Dashboard.
docs.sdk_i2: Place the file in your plugin's root directory.
docs.sdk_i3: Require and initialize in your plugin's main file.
docs.m_init: Initialize SDK with API URL and key
docs.bp_1: Cache license checks — Don't call the API on every page load. Cache results for 1-6 hours.
docs.bp_2: All API calls must use HTTPS in production.
docs.bp_3: Handle errors gracefully — If the API is unreachable, fail open or use cached results.
docs.bp_4: Always check license status before attempting to download.
docs.bp_5: Never expose your API key in client-side code or public repositories.

推广Cookie的有效期。例如30天表示用户点击推广链接后30天内的购买都归因于: Affiliate cookie validity. e.g. 30 days means purchases within 30 days after clicking the referral link are attributed to the affiliate.
推广员可提现的最低余额。: Minimum balance an affiliate can withdraw.
设置基础货币和汇率，用于支付转换。: Set base currency and exchange rate for payment conversion.
该货币兑1美元的汇率。例如：CNY: 7.25表示1美元=7.25人民币。: Exchange rate against 1 USD. e.g. CNY: 7.25 means 1 USD = 7.25 CNY.
将产品文件存储到云端，而非本地服务器磁盘。: Store product files in the cloud instead of local server disk.
新上传文件将使用选定服务商。其他服务商上的已有文件仍可访问。: New uploads will use the selected provider. Existing files on other providers remain accessible.
前往 dash.cloudflare.com → R2 → 创建API令牌。: Go to dash.cloudflare.com → R2 → Create API Token.
前往 https://portal.qiniu.com → 个人中心 → 密钥管: Go to https://portal.qiniu.com → Personal Center → Key Management.
配置短信服务，用于验证码、订单通知等。: Configure SMS service for verification codes, order notifications, etc.
所有短信功能的总开关。: Master switch for all SMS features.
选择短信服务商，仅使用所选服务商的配置。: Select SMS provider; only the selected provider's configuration will be used.
从短信服务商控制台获取模板ID，开关控制各通知类型。: Get template IDs from your SMS provider console. Toggles control each notification type.
WhatsApp号码（含国际区号），例如 +1 234567890: WhatsApp number with country code, e.g. +1 234567890
Thank you for your ticket. Our team will respond within 24 hours...
当用户提交新工单时，此消息将作为自动回复发送。留空则禁用。: This message will be automatically sent as a reply when a user submits a new ticket. Leave empty to disable.
从 open.weixin.qq.com → 应用管理 → 网站应用 获取。: Get from open.weixin.qq.com → App Management → Website Application.
从 Stripe Dashboard → Developers → API ke: Get from Stripe Dashboard → Developers → API keys. Starts with pk_test_ or pk_live_.
Get from Stripe Dashboard → Developers → API keys. Starts with sk_test_ or sk_live_. Keep this secret!
在 Stripe Dashboard → Developers → Webhoo: Create webhook at Stripe Dashboard → Developers → Webhooks. Endpoint: https://yourdomain.com/api/webhook/stripe. Copy the signing secret.
可选。Stripe Connect（市场提现）需要。从 Stripe Dashb: Optional. Required for Stripe Connect (marketplace payouts). Get from Stripe Dashboard → Settings → Connect.
小程序AppID或公众号AppID。从 mp.weixin.qq.com → 设: Mini Program AppID or Official Account AppID. Get from mp.weixin.qq.com → Settings → Basic Settings.
微信支付商户号。从 pay.weixin.qq.com → 账户中心 → 商户信: WeChat Pay Merchant ID. Get from pay.weixin.qq.com → Account Center → Merchant Info.
在 pay.weixin.qq.com → 账户中心 → API安全 → 设置A: Set in pay.weixin.qq.com → Account Center → API Security → Set APIv2 Key (32 chars).
从 pay.weixin.qq.com → 账户中心 → API安全 → 下载证: Download from pay.weixin.qq.com → Account Center → API Security → Download Cert. Upload to server and enter full path.
服务器间回调URL。必须是可公开访问的HTTPS地址。: Server-to-server callback URL. Must be publicly accessible HTTPS.
小程序JSAPI支付必需。在 pay.weixin.qq.com → 产品中心: Required for Mini Program JSAPI payments. Set in pay.weixin.qq.com → Product Settings → JSAPI Authorization Directory. Must include trailing slash.
从支付宝开放平台 → 我的应用 → 应用详情 获取。通常以2021开头。: Get from Alipay Open Platform → My Apps → App Details. Usually starts with 2021.
使用支付宝密钥工具生成。粘贴应用私钥（非文件内容）。: Generate with Alipay Key Tool. Paste the application private key (not the file content).
在支付宝开放平台上传公钥后，复制平台显示的支付宝公钥（非您自己的公钥）。: After uploading your public key on Alipay Open Platform, copy the Alipay public key (not your own) shown on the platform.
默认: https://openapi.alipay.com/gateway.d: Default: https://openapi.alipay.com/gateway.do (production). Use https://openapi.alipaydev.com/gateway.do for sandbox.
推荐使用RSA2 (SHA256)。必须与支付宝开放平台上的应用设置一致。: RSA2 (SHA256) is recommended for security. Must match your app settings on Alipay Open Platform.
服务器间回调。必须可公开访问。在代码中设置，非支付宝平台。: Server-to-server callback. Must be publicly accessible. Set in code, not on Alipay platform.
支付后用户浏览器跳转URL。通常为支付成功页面。: User browser redirect URL after payment. Usually your checkout success page.
R2 → 管理R2 API令牌 → 创建API令牌 → 对象读写。: R2 → Manage R2 API Tokens → Create API Token → Object Read & Write.
创建令牌时仅显示一次。请立即保存！: Only shown once when creating the token. Save it immediately!
创建API令牌时显示的S3兼容端点。: S3-compatible endpoint shown when you create the API token.
如果您为R2存储桶绑定了自定义域名。: If you bound a custom domain to the R2 bucket.
RAM控制台 → 创建AccessKey。建议使用具有OSS权限的子账号。: RAM console → Create AccessKey. Use a sub-account with OSS permissions.
格式: https://oss-{region}.aliyuncs.com —: Format: https://oss-{region}.aliyuncs.com — check your bucket region in OSS console.
自定义域名必须在OSS控制台进行CNAME绑定。: Custom domain must be CNAME-bound in OSS console.
CAM控制台 → 创建API密钥。建议使用具有COS权限的子账号。: CAM console → Create API Key. Use a sub-account with COS permissions.
格式: {名称}-{APPID}。在COS控制台 → 存储桶列表 查看。: Format: {name}-{APPID}. Check in COS console → Bucket List.
必须与COS控制台中的存储桶区域一致。: Must match the bucket region in COS console.
格式: https://cos.{region}.myqcloud.com —: Format: https://cos.{region}.myqcloud.com — auto-filled from region if left blank.
格式: https://s3-{region}.qiniucs.com — 查看: Format: https://s3-{region}.qiniucs.com — check Qiniu docs for your region.
七牛云要求绑定域名才能访问文件。从存储桶设置 → 域名设置 获取。: Qiniu requires a bound domain for file access. Get from bucket settings → Domain Settings.

例如 \"您的公司名\"（必须与腾讯云控制台已审核的签名一致）: e.g. "YourCompanyName" (must match approved signature in Tencent Cloud console)

developer.module_integrity_guard_desc: Detects if authorization code in the main file is deleted or tampered. Shows fullscreen warning and disables admin menus if tampered.
developer.module_secondary_check_desc: Injects reverse checks in subdirectory files. Detects tampering even if the main file injection is entirely removed.
developer.module_license_gate_desc: Injects license activation checks in plugin settings pages. Prevents saving settings or using features when not activated.
developer.module_auto_guardian_desc: Automatically installs a mu-plugin guardian process upon license activation to independently monitor code integrity.
